name: JOINTZ Hash Hole THCA Prerolls - Sativa - 3 Gram - 3-Pack
description:
Description

JOINTZ Hash Holes are brought to you by the same legendary collaboration between Ocho Extracts, Trip Drip, and Sugar that gave you our famous BITEZ Gummies. We’ve taken that same commitment to elite potency and mouthwatering flavor and rolled it into the ultimate smoking experience. This Sativa 3-pack is engineered for those who want the power of a "hash hole" without the mid-day slump.

Details

• 
Sativa Strains: Blueberry Kush, Grape Escape, Blue Zlushi

• 
Format: 3-Pack of 1-Gram Prerolls (3 Grams Total)

• 
Core: Infused Hash Batter "Hash Hole"

• 
Flower: Premium THCA Hemp Flower

• 
Compliance: 100% Hemp-Derived, 2018 Farm Bill Compliant

Cannabinoids

• 
THCA

• 
Hash Batter Concentrate

What makes Jointz a triple threat?

Premium THCA flower meet an infused hash batter core for a heavy-hitting, full-spectrum high.

Each Jointz preroll is meticulously packed with top-shelf THCA hemp flower and features a concentrated hash batter "hole" in the center. This "hash hole" construction ensures a slow, even burn that produces massive, milky clouds and a potency that standard prerolls simply can’t touch.

Which strains are in the Jointz Sativa 3-Pack?

Ignite your day with the vibrant flavors of Strawberry Sour Diesel, Blue Dream, and Fruit Punch.

We’ve curated a lineup of legendary Sativa-dominant profiles that offer a refreshing mix of gas, berries, and tropical fruit notes.

• 
Strawberry Sour Diesel: A pungent mix of fuel and sweet strawberries that provides an immediate, cerebral energy boost.

• 
Blue Dream: The gold standard of Sativas, offering a sweet berry aroma and a balanced, euphoric head high.

• 
Fruit Punch: A tropical explosion of citrus and cherry notes that keeps the vibes high and the conversation flowing.

Why is the "Hash Hole" a game changer?

The center-infused hash batter creates a "donut" burn that maximizes flavor and strength.

The hash hole isn't just for show—as the flower burns, the hash batter core melts into the embers, creating a hollow center (the "donut hole"). This allows for superior airflow and ensures you’re getting a potent dose of concentrate with every single pull, right down to the crutch.

How do I use Jointz?

Simply spark the tip, inhale, and let the hash batter core do the heavy lifting.

If you’re a seasoned pro, light up and enjoy the ride. If you’re new to the world of infused prerolls, start with a few hits and wait about 15 minutes to feel the full effects of the THCA and hash batter blend before diving back in.

What is THCA?

THCA is the natural precursor to THC that delivers the classic "high" when heated.

THCA is a non-psychoactive cannabinoid found in raw hemp, but once you apply a flame, it undergoes decarboxylation and converts into Delta-9 THC. This gives you a potent, authentic cannabis experience that is federally legal under the 2018 Farm Bill.

What is Hash Batter?

Hash batter is a high-potency concentrate that adds depth and "punch" to the flower.

By whipping hemp-derived extracts into a creamy, batter-like consistency, we create a concentrate that is rich in both cannabinoids and terpenes. Tucking this batter into the center of the joint elevates the potency to a "one-and-done" level for most smokers.

Full Panel COAs

[Strawberry Sour Diesel COA] | [Blue Dream COA] | [Fruit Punch COA]

THCA Disclaimer

This product is not available for shipment to the following states: Hawaii, Idaho, Minnesota, Oregon, Rhode Island, Utah, and Vermont.
